summary: Small indexed selector: reads a selector from this+0x1C and returns this+0x20 when it is 0, this+0x24 when it is 1, this+0x28 when it is 2, and 0 for any other value. Reads only; no writes. Called by EqualityStateCheck (004C9280) and ObjectPropertySetter (004C92B0), consistent with a state-keyed field accessor on a small state object.

local_names.selector: this+0x1C, index (0/1/2) choosing which field to return

operations.description: v1 = this[7]; load the selector index from this+0x1C; result = 0.
If !v1 (selector == 0) return this[8]; value at this+0x20.
v3 = v1 - 1; if !v3 (selector == 1) return this[9]; value at this+0x24.
If v3 == 1 (selector == 2) return this[10]; value at this+0x28.
Return 0 for any selector value outside {0, 1, 2}.
